blocks.title: <ico-recycle></ico-recycle> REPASO EXPRESS
blocks.intro: Recupera la lección de presentaciones. Une cada frase con su significado — sin mirar atrás.

blocks.title: <ico-phone></ico-phone> ON THE CALL
blocks.intro: Las frases que salvan una llamada: abrir, pedir que repitan, compartir pantalla y cerrar.

cells.body:
Hi, this is Ana from Lumen. · Is this a good time? · Do you have five minutes?
Al teléfono se dice this is, no "I am".
Can you hear me OK? · You're breaking up. · Could you speak up a little? · Sorry, could you repeat that?
Let me share my screen. · Can I put you on hold for a second? · Sorry — you go ahead. · Can I call you back in ten?
Let me take a message. · I'll pass that on. · Thanks for your time — talk soon.

parts.body: El voicemail en 4 tiempos: quién eres → por qué llamas → qué necesitas → tu número. Di el número despacio y dos veces: todo lo demás se puede repetir por email; el número, no.

parts.h: B2 STRETCH · control fino de la llamada
parts.body: "I'm afraid the line is quite poor — would you mind if I called you right back?" · "Just to make sure we're on the same page…" · "Sorry to interrupt, but could I jump in here?" · "Before we wrap up, could we confirm the next steps?"

blocks.stage: ① CALL LANGUAGE · abrir · reparar · cerrar

blocks.title: <ico-book></ico-book> REPORTED SPEECH
blocks.intro: Contar lo que dijo otra persona. La regla base: el verbo da un paso atrás en el tiempo.

cells.body:
"I am busy." → He said he was busy.
"I can't hear you." → He said he couldn't hear me.
"I'll call you back." → She said she would call me back.
"We finished it." → They said they had finished it.

"Are you free?" → She asked if I was free.
"What time is the call?" → He asked what time the call was. sin "did", orden normal

parts.body:
say vs. tell: tell necesita persona, say no. He told me he was late. He said he was late. He said me… He told that…
Y las palabras de tiempo se mueven: today → that day · tomorrow → the next day · here → there.

parts.h: B2 STRETCH · verbos que dicen más que said
parts.body: offer + to → "He offered to send the file." · suggest + -ing → "She suggested moving the call." · promise + to → "They promised to fix it." · complain (that) → "He complained that nobody had answered." · confirm (that) → "They confirmed that the invoice had been paid."

blocks.stage: ② GRAMMAR · contar lo que dijeron

blocks.title: <ico-star></ico-star> THE CALL AND THE MESSAGE
blocks.intro: Una videollamada con mala conexión, un voicemail… y alguien que tiene que pasar el recado. Ahí es donde vive el reported speech.
blocks.stage: ③ THE STORY · llamar y pasar el recado

blocks.title: REPORT IT
blocks.intro: Alguien dijo algo por teléfono. Cuéntaselo a tu colega.

items.q: "I'm in a meeting." → He said he ___ in a meeting.
"We'll send the invoice on Friday." → They said they ___ the invoice on Friday.
"Did you get my email?" → He asked ___ I had gotten his email.
"Where is the report?" → He asked ___.
"Please call me back." → She ___ call her back.

speaking.prompt: Cuenta la última llamada de trabajo que tuviste: "He said…", "She asked if…", "They told me…" — tres frases, en voz alta.
speaking.starter: A client called yesterday. He said the order hadn't arrived, and he asked if we could send it again…

blocks.stage: ④ PRACTICE · elige la respuesta

blocks.title: RIGHT OR WRONG?
blocks.intro: Frases de llamada y de recado: unas funcionan, otras te delatan.

items.q: "He said me that he was busy."
options: Incorrect — "He told me…" o "He said that…"

items.q: No escuchas bien al cliente. ¿Qué dices?
options: Sorry, you're breaking up — could you repeat that?

items.q: ¿Qué NO puede faltar en un voicemail?
"She said she ___ call me the next day."

blocks.title: ORDENA LA FRASE
blocks.intro: Toca las palabras para formar la frase correcta.

items.answer: Hi this is Ana from Lumen
He said he would call me back
She asked if I was free at three

blocks.title: LO QUE DIJO vs. LO QUE CUENTAS
blocks.intro: La misma llamada, dos versiones: la directa (lo que oíste) y la indirecta (lo que le cuentas a tu colega). Cambiar bien de una a otra es toda la lección.

pair.b: He said he would send the file that afternoon.

items.q: ¿Cuál es lo que la persona dijo por teléfono?
¿Qué pasó con will al pasar a B?
Tu jefe pregunta qué dijo el cliente. ¿Qué contestas?
options: He said he will send it this afternoon and he asks if we can wait.
He said he would send it that afternoon and asked if we could wait.
He say he send it and ask we wait.

items.q: "Can you call me tomorrow?" — ¿cómo lo cuentas al día siguiente?
options: She asked if I could call her that day.
She asked can I call her tomorrow.
She said me to call tomorrow.

blocks.title: AUDIO 1 · THE VIDEO CALL
blocks.desc: Una videollamada con mala conexión. Fíjate en las frases de reparación: repetir, hablar más fuerte, compartir pantalla.

questions.q: Why does Ana turn her camera off?
What does Ana need from Toni?
What does Toni do at the end?
options: He asks to call back in ten minutes

speaking.prompt: Eres Ana. Abre la llamada, di que no escuchas bien, y pide la aprobación antes del viernes.

transcript.html: Hi Toni, can you hear me OK?
Hi Ana — you're breaking up a little. Could you speak up?
Is that better? Let me turn my camera off — the connection is poor today.
Much better. Is this still a good time for you?
It is. Let me share my screen — can you see the invoice?
Sorry — you go ahead. Yes, I can see it now.
Great. The client asked for a discount, so I need your approval before Friday.
Can I call you back in ten? I want to check the numbers first.
Perfect. Thanks for your time — talk soon.

blocks.stage: ⑤ LISTENING · la llamada y el recado

blocks.title: AUDIO 2 · THE VOICEMAIL, THEN THE MESSAGE
blocks.desc: Primero el voicemail de Toni. Después, Ana le cuenta el recado a un colega. La misma información, dos gramáticas.

questions.q: What does he ask Ana to do?
options: Check with the supplier and call him back

questions.q: How does Ana report it? "He said the order still ___ arrived."

transcript.html: Hi Ana, this is Toni. I'm calling about the Delta Foods order — it still hasn't arrived. Could you check with the supplier and call me back before six? I'm at five five five, oh one four two.
Toni called about Delta Foods. He said the order still hadn't arrived, and he asked me to check with the supplier.
He also asked if I could call him back before six.

blocks.title: <ico-pen></ico-pen> THE MESSAGE NOTE
blocks.intro: Alguien llamó a tu jefe y tú tomaste el recado. Escribe la nota: 4 frases en reported speech con lo que dijo y lo que pidió.
checklist: Quién llamó, de dónde y cuándo
blocks.placeholder: Mr. Vega from Delta Foods called this morning. He said...
blocks.example: ___ from ___ called ___. He said (that) ___. He also said ___. He asked if ___, and he asked me to ___. His number is ___.
blocks.exampleLabel: COMPLETA LA NOTA — 4 frases en reported speech
blocks.hw: Deja un voicemail real de 30 segundos (WhatsApp vale) con los 4 tiempos: quién · por qué · qué necesitas · tu número. Después escribe lo que dijiste en estilo indirecto.
blocks.stage: ⑥ WRITING · en clase o tarea (HW)

rubric.d: La nota tiene quién llamó, qué dijo, qué preguntó y qué pidió.
Usaste reported speech bien al menos 4 veces, con said / told / asked if / asked me to.
Tu jefe podría actuar solo con esa nota, sin volver a escuchar el mensaje.
